title: Chemical energetics
overview: A focused revision guide to chemical energetics.

sections.title: Enthalpy change ΔH
content: Exothermic releases energy (ΔH negative); endothermic absorbs energy (ΔH positive).

sections.title: Hess's law
content: Enthalpy change is independent of route. Draw a cycle via a common intermediate and add/subtract arrows to find the unknown ΔH.

examTips: Keep Hess cycle arrow directions consistent with the given definitions — an inconsistent cycle is the most common source of sign errors.
